teaching.en: I was wondering if you could keep the music down after eleven.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podrías bajar la música después de las once.
teaching.explanationEs: I was wondering if… convierte una petición directa en algo indirecto y amable.

choices.text: You never tidy the kitchen, so do it now.
Tidy the kitchen tonight or I will tell the landlord.
I was wondering if you could tidy the kitchen tonight.

feedback.es: La queja suave es indirecta y no acusa; las otras usan reproche o amenaza.

hint.es: La suave es indirecta y no acusa a nadie.

feedback.es: If only + pasado expresa un deseo sobre la situación presente.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace la hablante.

choices.text: She asks politely for help with the rubbish.
She complains that Sam already took the rubbish out.
She orders Sam to leave the flat.

feedback.es: La hablante describe el problema con el cubo lleno y pide con «I was wondering if…».

origin.audio: Hi Sam, I was wondering if you could take out the rubbish tonight. The bin has been full every morning. Thanks so much.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase reporta «Can you pay the bill today?»?

choices.text: She asked whether could I pay the bill that day.
She asked whether I could pay the bill that day.
She asked can I pay the bill that day.

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada pasa can a could y mantiene el orden afirmativo tras whether.

prompt.es: Escribe a Sam: problema, deseo, petición indirecta, pregunta reportada y cierre.

answer.text: Hi Sam, I hope your day went well. I wanted to talk about two small things in the flat. Lately, the kitchen has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and the music has been loud after eleven. I am sure you do not notice it, and I do not want to blame anyone. I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day, and if only the walls were thicker, I would not need to mention the music. I was wondering if you could keep the volume down after eleven, and I would really appreciate it if you could tidy the kitchen tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. Could we talk about it this weekend? Thanks a lot for being so considerate, and please tell me if anything bothers you, too.
accepted: Hi Sam, I hope your day went well. I wanted to talk about two small things in the flat. Lately, the kitchen has been a bit of a mess in the evenings, and the music has been loud after eleven. I am sure you do not notice it, and I do not want to blame anyone. I wish you would wash your dishes on the same day, and if only the walls were thicker, I would not need to mention the music. I was wondering if you could keep the volume down after eleven, and I would really appreciate it if you could tidy the kitchen tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. Could we talk about it this weekend? Thanks a lot for being so considerate, and please tell me if anything bothers you, too.

Hello Sam, I wanted to write to you about the flat. Lately, the kitchen has been untidy, and the music has been loud late at night. I am not angry, and I am sure it is easily done. I wish you would tidy up after cooking, and if only the walls were thicker, it would be easier for me to sleep. I was wondering if you could turn the music down after eleven. I would appreciate it if you could clean the kitchen tonight. Mia asked me whether we could agree on a rota for the cleaning, and I think it would help all of us. Shall we talk on Saturday? Thank you for understanding, Sam.

feedback.es: Un mensaje completo describe sin acusar, usa wish o if only, pide de forma indirecta, reporta la pregunta de Mia y cierra con agradecimiento.

origin.text: Vives con un compañero de piso, Sam. Escríbele un mensaje de unas 190–250 palabras: describe el problema (cocina desordenada y música tarde) sin acusar; expresa un deseo con wish o if only; haz una petición indirecta con I was wondering if…; incluye una pregunta reportada (Mia te preguntó si podíais acordar un turno de limpieza); y termina agradeciendo.
